description: This file defines the WNCharacters class, which manages character data for the Wesnoth Scenario Editor, including attributes like name, unit type, hit points, traits, death messages, AI, and in-play status, with methods for serialization, data manipulation, and event export.

classes.name: WNCharacters
classes.description: A class representing a collection of characters with attributes and behaviors for the scenario editor.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a new WNCharacters instance with default character data.

methods.name: dealloc
methods.description: Releases retained objects upon deallocation.

methods.name: encodeWithCoder
methods.description: Encodes the object for serialization.

methods.name: initWithCoder
methods.description: Initializes the object from serialized data.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of characters.

methods.name: newCharacter
methods.description: Adds a new default character and returns its index.

methods.name: setNameAtIndex:to:
methods.description: Sets the name of a character at a specific index.

methods.name: getNameAtIndex:
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a character at a specific index.

methods.name: getUnitTypeAtIndex:
methods.description: Retrieves the unit type of a character at a specific index.

methods.name: setUnitTypeAtIndex:to:
methods.description: Sets the unit type of a character at a specific index.

methods.name: setDialogImageAtIndex:to:
methods.description: Sets the dialog image for a character at a specific index.

methods.name: getDialogImageAtIndex:
methods.description: Retrieves the dialog image of a character at a specific index.

methods.name: setHPAtIndex:to:
methods.description: Sets the hit points percentage for a character at a specific index.

methods.name: getHPAtIndex:
methods.description: Retrieves the hit points percentage of a character at a specific index.

methods.name: setDeathMessageAtIndex:to:
methods.description: Sets the death message for a character at a specific index.

methods.name: getDeathMessageAtIndex:
methods.description: Retrieves the death message of a character at a specific index.

methods.name: setTrait:atIndex:to:
methods.description: Sets a trait (1 or 2) for a character at a specific index.

methods.name: getTrait:atIndex:
methods.description: Retrieves a trait (1 or 2) for a character at a specific index.

methods.name: setAIAtIndex:to:
methods.description: Sets the AI type for a character at a specific index.

methods.name: getAIAtIndex:
methods.description: Retrieves the AI type of a character at a specific index.

methods.name: setDeathActionAtIndex:to:
methods.description: Sets the death action for a character at a specific index.

methods.name: getDeathActionAtIndex:
methods.description: Retrieves the death action of a character at a specific index.

methods.name: initInPlay
methods.description: Initializes the in-play dictionary.

methods.name: clearInPlay
methods.description: Clears the in-play dictionary.

methods.name: setInPlay:
methods.description: Marks a character as in play by index.

methods.name: exportCharacterEventsFromScenario:
methods.description: Exports character-related events for characters marked as in play, based on the scenario.
